clips.title: The story
paras: Wrenix the Wretched sends new Shattered Hand rogues against the Southsea Freebooters near Ratchet. Aboard the Tide Razor, they face pirates, locked strongboxes, and a dangerous guardian before claiming the Southsea Treasure.

Wrenix the Wretched, a goblin contact in Ratchet, tests aspiring Shattered Hand operatives. He sends rogues south along the Barrens coast to a cove where the Tide Razor lies at anchor, crewed by Southsea Freebooters. They must board without being seen, enter the pirates’ den where cutpurses train, pick the strongboxes in the hold, and bring back the plunder.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I don't mean to scare you, friend, but the last five thieves I sent to steal the southsea treasure came back to me in pieces.

South along the coast you'll find Tide Razor, the southsea freebooter's ship. Nestled in the hold is the payoff - the southsea treasure. On the second level of that ship is the pirate's den, a place where they train all of their thieves.
Board that ship, steal the treasure, and bring it back to me. Use the pirate's den if you need to practice your thievery, but be careful!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Well, at least you still have all of your body parts. Did you find the treasure?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Incredible! Improbable! Simply amazing! You've got talent, friend. Either that or you're the luckiest one alive!
Here's your cut of the action. I'm sure you would make better use of this stuff than I could.
